about: mbx's machine-wide pool on an 18-core host during one land gate of a consumer workspace, 2026-11-16 22:11:00 to 2026-11-16 22:35:30 local: every admission whose wait or hold overlaps the window and whose end mbx observed (5 had none and are left out), from mbx's decision log joined to its observation log by name and admission instant; times in milliseconds from the window's start. `cpus` is the ask, `granted` what the admission held, `hold_ms` its recorded hold on that grant. The leaf is the gate's host test suite, a reserved nextest leaf; its cases are its recorded walls in the order its record closed them.
